snippet.title: ¿Qué hace Sheinbaum en China? La agenda clave en la cumbre APEC 2026

snippet.title: PM Modi Philippines strategy: ये कैसे कपड़े पहन आए मोदी, गाड़ी से निकले, असली खेल क्या है !
snippet.description:
आज प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी के इन कपड़ो की चर्चा हो रही है, वैसे ये खबर इतनी छोटी नहीं है की सिर्फ कपड़ो तक सिमटकर रह जाए, असली खेल बहुत बड़ा है, खेल क्या है वो समझने से पहले फिर भी एक बार आपको इन कपड़ो के बारे में बता देते है, दरअसल PM मोदी ने जो कपडे पहने है उन्हें बारोंग तागालोग कहते है, जो फिलीपींस का पारंपरिक और आधिकारिक राष्ट्रीय पुरुष परिधान (National Dress) है। 
प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी फिलीपींस की राजधानी मनीला में सम्मेलनों में हिस्सा लेने पहुंचे है पहला है 23वां आसियान-भारत शिखर सम्मेलन जो दक्षिण-पूर्व एशिया के 11 देशों का एक प्रमुख क्षेत्रीय, आर्थिक और राजनीतिक संगठन है, और दूसरा है East Asia समिट जो 19 प्रमुख देशों का एक बड़ा मंच है जहा दुनिया की बड़ी महाशक्तियाँ जैसे भारत, अमेरिका, चीन, रूस और जापान एक ही मेज पर बैठते हैं।  पुतिन-जिनपिंग नहीं आ रहे है मगर ट्रम्प आएंगे और अमेरिका ने अपनी तरफ से बोल दिया है की वो PM मोदी से मिलेंगे, अमेरिकी मिडटर्म चुनावों में हार के बाद पहली बार ट्रम्प का PM मोदी से आमना सामना होगा, बहरहाल यहाँ असली खेल मेजबान और एक ख़ास मेहमान के बीच है यानि फिलीपींस और भारत के बीच है, दरअसल PM मोदी दुश्मन के दुश्मन को और मजबूत करने गए है, आप जानते ही है की फिलीपींस वो देश है जिसका चीन से जबरदस्त विवाद चल रहा है और इसी विवाद से निपटने के लिए फिलीपींस वो पहला देश बना जिसने भारत से ब्रह्मोस मिसाइल खरीदी है, फिलीपींस अब भारत से Akash Air Defense System भी लेना चाहता है, इसके अलावा फिलीपींस ने भारत से कहा है की आप जो हमे ब्रह्मोस मिसाइल दे रहे है उसे थोड़ा और घातक बना दीजिए

Today, there is a lot of talk about Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s attire. However, this story goes far beyond just his clothes; there is a much larger game at play. Before we delve into what that game is, let’s take a look at the outfit itself: PM Modi is wearing a 'Barong Tagalog'—the traditional and official national dress for men in the Philippines.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi has arrived in Manila, the capital of the Philippines, to attend two major summits. The first is the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit—ASEAN being a key regional, economic, and political organization comprising 11 Southeast Asian nations. The second is the East Asia Summit, a significant platform involving 19 major nations, where global powers—including India, the United States, China, Russia, and Japan—sit at the same table. While Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping will not be attending, Donald Trump will be there, and the U.S. has confirmed that he will meet with PM Modi. This will be their first face-to-face encounter following the U.S. midterm elections. Ultimately, however, the real strategic play here involves the host nation, the Philippines, and India. In essence, PM Modi is working to further strengthen the position of an "enemy’s enemy." As is well known, the Philippines is currently embroiled in a major dispute with China. To address this, the Philippines became the first nation to purchase the BrahMos missile system from India. Furthermore, the Philippines is now looking to acquire India’s 'Akash' air defense system. Additionally, the Philippines has requested that India enhance the lethality of the BrahMos missiles being supplied to them.

📖 Título original: Blue Bloods
📺 Universal+
🎭 Gênero: Drama policial
📅 Ano: 2010–2024
🟡 IMDb: 7,7/10 — série

👥 Elenco da cena: Vanessa Ray, Will Estes e Lauren Patten

📋 SINOPSE:
Durante a patrulha, Eddie e Rachel seguem um cachorro que as leva até uma ocorrência. De volta à delegacia, Eddie se apega ao animal e defende que ele fique, mesmo depois de ele fazer bagunça. Jamie tem dúvidas, mas, durante um passeio, o cachorro volta a tomar a iniciativa e ajuda os dois em outra ocorrência.

💡 CURIOSIDADES:

🔹 Vanessa Ray interpreta Eddie Janko, Will Estes vive Jamie Reagan e Lauren Patten faz Rachel Witten, a parceira de patrulha de Eddie.

🔹 É o cachorro que vai à frente no primeiro encontro: Eddie e Rachel o seguem para descobrir onde ele quer chegar.

🔹 O nome que o cachorro ganha na história é Jamko, uma brincadeira que junta Jamie e Janko.

This video looks at her career, what she said in full, what she did in 2026, and why a result of eight flipped seats changes the question.

The three-seat scenario is hypothetical. The ranked-choice measure margin is unofficial until certification. Quotation marks on screen are exact words; everything else is marked as a paraphrase. Lines marked "Analysis · our read" are this channel's reading, not reporting. Murkowski has not announced any change of party.

snippet.title: 미국이 반도체를 막는데, 왜 중국 수입 1위는 6개월째 한국일까?
snippet.description:
미국이 중국에 첨단 반도체를 못 팔게 막는 한복판에서, 2026년 4~9월 중국 수입시장 1위는 6개월 연속 한국이었습니다(한국무역협회가 중국 쪽 수입 통계를 정리 · 1~3월은 대만 1위). 1~9월 중국의 한국산 수입은 2,362억 달러, 점유율 9.8%로 2019년 이후 7년 만에 되찾은 자리입니다.
이 영상은 «한국이 대만을 이겼다» 는 환호 대신 숫자로 봅니다 — 2013~2019년 7년 연속 1위였던 한국이 2020년 대만에 밀리고 2023년 수교 이후 첫 중국과의 무역적자를 낸 과정, 메모리 값 급등과 미국 규제가 비켜 간 일반 메모리가 판을 뒤집은 이유.
그런데 대만은 밀려난 게 아니라 AI 칩·서버를 들고 미국으로 무게를 옮겼고, 한국은 미국 수입시장에서도 9위에서 6위로 올라섰습니다. 값이 만든 1위가 얼마나 튼튼한지, 한국이 챙길 세 가지 숙제까지 정리했습니다.
수치는 2026년 11월 14일까지 발표된 자료 기준이며, 이달 중순 중국 선전 APEC 미중 정상회담은 «예정» 기준으로 말했습니다.

snippet.title: น้องคนนี้คือใคร? ทำไมยิ้มเก่งจัง! น้องคือ "เอลฟ์น้อย" ที่ใจดีที่สุด!
snippet.description:
มีคนถาม น้องคนนี้คือใคร ทำไมยิ้มเก่งจัง แล้วทำไมน้องถึงตัวเล็กกว่าวัยเดียวกัน? 🥰👦

น้องคนนี้คือน้องคนเก่งจากประเทศไทยครับ! น้องกำลังฝึกกายภาพบำบัดในน้ำอยู่!

น้องมีภาวะที่เรียกว่า "วิลเลียมส์ ซินโดรม" (Williams Syndrome) หรือที่หลายคนเรียกว่า "กลุ่มอาการเอลฟ์น้อย" เพราะน้องๆ กลุ่มนี้จะมีใบหน้าที่น่ารักเป็นเอกลักษณ์!

น้องๆ จะมีหน้าผากกว้าง ตาห่างกันนิดนึง จมูกเล็กๆ รอยยิ้มกว้างๆ น่ารักมาก! แล้วที่สำคัญ น้องๆ กลุ่มนี้จะ ใจดี อารมณ์ดี ยิ้มเก่ง ชอบเข้าหาคนมากๆ! เป็นเสน่ห์ของน้องๆ เลย!

แต่น้องๆ จะตัวเล็กกว่าเพื่อนวัยเดียวกัน แขนขาจะเล็ก กล้ามเนื้อจะอ่อนแรงกว่านิดนึง การทรงตัวก็จะยากกว่าเพื่อนๆ!

การเรียนรู้ การพูด การดูแลตัวเอง ก็จะช้ากว่าเพื่อนๆ นิดหน่อยครับ!

น้องในคลิปกำลังทำ "ธาราบำบัด" หรือกายภาพในน้ำอยู่! น้ำจะช่วยพยุงตัวน้อง ทำให้ฝึกกล้ามเนื้อ ฝึกการทรงตัวได้ง่ายขึ้น!

ดูสิครับ ครูฝึกประคองน้องตลอด น้องก็พยายามเต็มที่เลย เก่งมากๆ!

แล้วภาวะนี้เกิดจากอะไร?

เกิดจากโครโมโซมคู่ที่ 7 มียีนหายไปนิดนึงครับ เป็นเรื่องของยีนตั้งแต่เกิด ไม่ใช่โรคติดต่อ ไม่ใช่เพราะพ่อแม่เลี้ยงผิด!

ตอนนี้ยังไม่มีวิธีรักษาให้หายขาด แต่ฝึกแบบนี้ไปเรื่อยๆ น้องก็จะแข็งแรงขึ้นทุกวัน!

ส่งกำลังใจให้น้องกันหน่อย! คุณเคยเจอน้องๆ กลุ่มเอลฟ์น้อยแบบนี้ไหม? เม้นให้กำลังใจน้องหน่อย! ❤️👇

snippet.title: Boneless Chicken Bhorta #shorts #asmr
snippet.description:
Chicken Bhorta / Mashed Spiced Chicken Recipe 

1. Boneless chicken pieces: ~10–12 medium-sized chunks (looks like roughly 250–350 g)
2. Cooking oil: Enough for shallow-frying/pan-frying in two batches (plus a few drops drizzled at the end)
3. Dried whole red chilies: 3 chilies
4. Whole garlic cloves: ~7–8 cloves (peeled)
5. Red/purple onions: ~1.5–2 medium onions, sliced (some sautéed, some added raw)
6. Whole red tomatoes: 3 medium tomatoes
7. Fresh green & red chilies: ~2–3 chilies, finely chopped
8. Fresh coriander leaves (cilantro): A generous handful, chopped
9. Lemon juice: Freshly squeezed (looks like ~1–2 teaspoons / half a lemon)

Seasonings & spices (visual estimate):
1. Salt (to taste)
2. Turmeric powder (~1/2 tsp)
3. Red chili powder (~1/2–1 tsp)
4. Roasted cumin/coriander spice mix (~1/2–1 tsp)
5. Black pepper powder (~1/4–1/2 tsp)
6. Steamed white rice: 1 small bowl/portion for serving
Step-by-Step Recipe
1. Toast the Dried Red Chilies 
2. Heat oil in a pan and fry 3 dried whole red chilies until darkened/crisp, then lift them out.
3. Crush Chilies with Salt: Place the fried dried chilies into an earthen/clay bowl, sprinkle salt, and crush/rub them with your fingers into coarse chili flakes.
4. Pan-Fry Garlic, Tomatoes, and Onions
5. Add peeled garlic cloves and whole tomatoes to the warm oil in the pan.
6. Slice red onions and add them to the pan as well, stirring and sautéing until the garlic browns, the onions soften, and the tomatoes blister/cook through.
7. Mash the Cooked Aromatics & Tomatoes
8. Transfer the sautéed garlic, onions, and cooked tomatoes into the clay bowl with the crushed chili and salt.
9. Squeeze and mash the tomatoes and softened aromatics together by hand.
Marinate the Chicken:
1. In a bowl, take the boneless chicken pieces and season with turmeric powder, red chili powder, ground spice mix (cumin/coriander), salt, and black pepper.
2. Mix thoroughly by hand so every piece is evenly coated.
Pan-Fry the Marinated Chicken
1. Add the marinated chicken pieces to the hot oil in the pan and cook until browned and cooked through.
2. Pound the Cooked Chicken
3. Transfer the cooked chicken pieces into a stone mortar and pound them with a pestle until shredded and mashed.
Combine & Mix Everything
1. Add the shredded chicken into the clay bowl with the mashed tomato-chili-onion mixture.
2. Add raw sliced onions, chopped green and red chilies, chopped fresh coriander, and squeeze lemon juice over top.
3. Mix everything together well by hand, then shape portions into a round ball/patty if desired.
4. Serve: Plate a mound of steamed rice, place the spiced chicken bhorta mixture on top, drizzle a little oil over it, and enjoy.
